title: pnpm 12 Shipped. npm Still Installs 11.
caption:
I ran pnpm --version expecting 12 and got 11.24.0.

pnpm 12 has been out since Aug 26, and 12.1.0 landed Aug 29. But on the registry the latest tag still resolves to 11.24.0, so a plain global install quietly leaves you on the old major.

Not a bug. They keep a latest-N tag for every major going back to v1, and latest moves on their schedule, not the release's. Still caught me out.

What does your pnpm --version say?

slides.headline:
pnpm 12 shipped.
npm installs 11.
slides.sub: 12.0.0 landed Aug 26. The latest tag still points at 11.24.0.

slides.headline:
Ask for 12
by name.
slides.sub: npm i -g pnpm@12 installs 12.1.0. Drop the tag and you stay on 11.24.0.
